description: Turn a Discord server template link (discord.new/CODE or discord.com/template/CODE) into a blueprint: its roles, categories, channels, and who can see and post where. Nothing is built; plan the result with plan_server_build to build it on a server, after editing it if wanted. Optionally save it with save_as. The template's server settings (verification level, media filter, notifications) are listed for update_server, since blueprints do not carry them.

save_as.description: Save the blueprint under this name.

template.description: The template link or its code.

name: import_server_template
title: Import server template
